explanation: rv_ioc_lin.xml defines the 18 composite risk-factor groups used by scanning-lin.py's threat-scoring engine. Each vector_group has a name (e.g. RansomewareAndHoneypotDetection, AbnormalProcessAndCpuLoad, DataBaseBreachAndDBDeletionAndCpuLoad) and 2-4 underlying vectors it combines. This file is the schema -- it doesn't hold live values, it defines what scanning-lin.py's hardcoded factor logic is supposed to implement.

metadata.reader: scanning-lin.py (hardcoded factor names must match this file's <name> values)
metadata.caveat: threatrisk.xml's template has 19 threat blocks vs this file's 18 groups -- one orphaned entry, SqlLibModificationAndMoreCpuLoad, has no backing logic
metadata.raw_content_note: verified structure from the investigation -- each vector_group's <name> must exactly match a factorname scanning-lin.py hardcodes, or that factor silently never scores
